changeSet.sql:
UPDATE theme SET layout = jsonb_set( layout, '{tiles,marquee}', (layout->'tiles'->'marquee') || '{"hidden": false, "edition": "shaft", "col": 12, "row": 22, "colSpan": 7, "rowSpan": 7}'::jsonb ) WHERE key = 'wave-03';
UPDATE theme SET layout = jsonb_set( layout, '{mobileOrder}', '["waveSwitcher", "music", "stats", "latestDrop", "photoDrops", "ride", "projects", "social", "calendar", "marquee"]'::jsonb ) WHERE key = 'wave-03';
